hero.title: Help
hero.summary: A practical guide to finding RNA entries, following probing-to-structure links, and downloading the data you need.
hero.detail: Start with the Entry table, then use the detail page to compare the profile, secondary structure, and tertiary structure views.

sections.title: About FoldBridge
sections.body: FoldBridge connects residue-level RNA chemical-probing profiles from RMDB and RASP to experimentally resolved PDB chains. Each Entry keeps the source signal, sequence mapping, structure state, and confidence evidence together so you can move from an observed probing signal to the structure it maps onto.

sections.title: How to contact us
sections.body: For questions about an Entry, profile, mapping, or confidence label, please include the PDB ID, chain, profile name, and the page URL. The project repository and current site address are available in the footer.

items.body: Open the Entry table to search by molecule name, PDB ID, probing technology, RNA family, motif, or structure class. Use the grouping controls to narrow a large result set.
Select a row to open the structure-linked Entry page. The top table records the source family and profile, while the Profile panel shows the currently selected signal.
The measurement family A–F identifies what was measured; the recall tier describes how strongly the signal agrees with the deposited structure. The family is not a quality ranking.
The 1D alignment and 2D VARNA view use the same profile colors. Select a nucleotide to keep the position traceable across the aligned sequence and secondary structure.
The Mol* viewer colors the target chain with the active profile. Use the viewer controls to rotate, reset, and inspect the mapped residue in its tertiary context.
The Entry button exports a compact JSON metadata file and an HTML summary of the current structure-linked record.
The Profile button exports one CSV row per mapped position plus a JSON color map for the active profile.
The 3D button exports the target-chain and full-structure mmCIF files together with the profile reactivity-color map.
Tell us which PDB ID, chain, profile, or residue is affected and describe what looks wrong. A screenshot or downloaded CSV is helpful.
For interface or visualization ideas, include the workflow you were trying to complete and the point where the page became unclear.
Please share the page URL, selected profile, and any filter settings so we can reproduce the same view.
